title: Voluntary oral administration of drugs in mice
protocol: Remove food from mouse cages at 5 pm.
Next morning between 8:30 to 9:00 am, scoop out vehicle jelly and cut into equal 8 pieces.
Place one piece of jelly on the cage floor and put lid back on.
Wait until mouse finishes the jelly then re-feed the mouse.
Give one piece of vehicle jelly to each mouse in the morning for the following three days without fasting them overnight.
If drug treatment will be given at a particular time, place the jelly on the cage floor at that time instead of the morning.
If drug treatment will be given multiple times per day, give the piece of vehicle jelly at those times.
Make fresh vehicle and drug jellies every 2-3 days.
Give about 1/8th of vehicle jelly to mice in the control group.
Give about 1/8th of treatment jelly to mice in the treatment group.
Calculate the amount of glucose jelly each mouse needs based on its body weight.
Prepare the glucose jelly the day before the test day for oral glucose tolerance test.
Give the calculated amount of glucose jelly to each corresponding mouse.
Record the 0 time point when the mouse finishes the entire piece of glucose jelly.
